messages:
Maya (eng-ml): FYI, canary for nebula-lite-v2 int4 went out last night. We're seeing a small but consistent P95 latency uptick (~2.3%) and a handful of malformed JSON when the model emits tool-call payloads. @Arjun @Liam
Arjun (eng-runtime): Thanks — any reproducible example? quant config used?
Maya (eng-ml): Repro steps below, happens intermittently when streaming and seq_len > 512. Example response truncated / missing closing brace: 
```
Request: {\n  "input": "generate tool call for fetch_user"\n}
Streaming chunk 4: {"tool": "fetch_user", "args": {"id": 123"\nStreaming chunk 5: }
```
Arjun (eng-runtime): Hmm looks like chunk boundary split inside JSON. Could be streaming buffer flush + tokenizer break after quant kernel change. Which kernel/compile flags did this build use?
Maya (eng-ml): Build notes: PTQ int4, fused_attn enabled, kernel set to avx2-opt for CPU fallback, gpu path uses fmha-fused. Canary tag: nebula-lite-v2-int4-2026-03-19.
Liam (infra): I pulled the request traces and SSE/streaming flushes align with a few ~10-30ms GC-like pauses on the worker that handled those requests. PID 9421. Attaching trace link: https://console.redwood/internal/traces/nebula/9421 (private)
Nisha (oncall): Oncall alert INC-2301 triggered at 03:12 for elevated error-rate on canary tool-calls. Error-rate peaked at 0.8% over 15m. Marking as SLO risk.
Sophia (product): How customer-facing is this? Are any end-users affected or just synthetic canary traffic?
Maya (eng-ml): Mostly canary traffic and some low-volume user sessions. The malformed JSON causes downstream tool invocations to fail (no retry path right now).
Arjun (eng-runtime): Quick mitigation options: 1) disable streaming for canary (serve as full response) 2) disable fused_attn kernel for int4 path 3) pin to fp16 variant while we debug quant kernel. I can push a canary rollback or config patch. Which do we prefer?
Maya (eng-ml): Let's do minimal blast radius: disable streaming on canary and run smoke harness across longer sequences, and if still flaky rollback to fp16.
deploy-bot: Canary config update applied: nebula-lite-v2-int4 -> streaming=false (canary) at 3523456890
Maya (eng-ml): Running smoke eval now: `python infra/evals/run_smoke.py --model nebula-lite-v2-int4 --seq-len 1024 --repeat 200 --stream=false`
Arjun (eng-runtime): Also ask infra to collect GPU-side nvprof/nvtx during repro. Liam, can you attach those traces?
Liam (infra): On it. I'll schedule a dedicated repro node and attach perf counters + kernel selection logs. ETA ~40m.
Maya (eng-ml): Quick note on repro: set seed=42 and sampling top_k=50 to hit same tokenization boundaries.
Sophia (product): Agree with rollback if we see errors after smoke. We should also notify customers if we escalate.
Nisha (oncall): I'll open an incident and set status page draft if it becomes customer visible. INC-2301 created.
Arjun (eng-runtime): Follow-ups for post-mortem: 1) verify streaming chunk atomicity guarantees with quantized kernels 2) add a parser-level resilience for partial chunks (temporary) 3) test vectorized KV-cache alignment across quant variants 4) automated smoke for seq_len=1k+ on new quant builds
Maya (eng-ml): Results: smoke run (200 iters) returned 0 malformed JSON after disabling streaming — preliminary green. But P95 still +1.8% vs fp16 baseline.
Arjun (eng-runtime): OK rollback plan: if malformed outputs reappear when re-enabling streaming, we'll pin fp16 for canary and continue kernel debugging offline. Can we schedule deeper eval on quantized kernels (fused_attn on/off)?
Maya (eng-ml): Yes — I'll run a small A/B: fused_attn=true vs false with streaming disabled, collect token-level diffs and latency.
Liam (infra): I'll provision extra capacity for parallel A/B and collect perf counters.
Sophia (product): ETA on rollback if needed?
Arjun (eng-runtime): We can rollback canary to nebula-lite-v2-fp16 in ~10m if smoke shows regressions.
Maya (eng-ml): For now marking canary paused for streaming. Follow-up checklist (short):
- [ ] Finish A/B fused_attn smoke (Maya)
- [ ] Attach GPU traces + kernel logs (Liam)
- [ ] Add parser resilience for chunked JSON (Arjun)
- [ ] Decide on rollback by 1hr (all)
- [ ] Draft customer comms if rollback impacts prod (Sophia/Nisha)

Maya (eng-ml): Leaving detailed notes in the incident: https://internal.redwood/incidents/INC-2301 — tagging for postmortem once resolved. :white_check_mark:
Arjun (eng-runtime): Thanks team. If anyone reproduces deterministic case, paste minimal seed + request here and I'll root-cause.
Liam (infra): Got the repro node up, uploading perf logs to the incident now.
Nisha (oncall): Monitoring continues. I will alert if error-rate crosses 1.5% again.
Sophia (product): Good triage. Keep me posted on rollback decision.
Maya (eng-ml): Will do — updating thread as results come in.
